source_compatibility.conditional_on: Embedded assets, Stamps, face appearances or exact split-line recipes
source_compatibility.container_boundary: Containers explicitly reject embedded appearance ownership/merge until supported; bare split-line recipes retain format 39.

feedback_audit.scope: Aggregate authorized local activity review; no equivalent design-quality, performance or cost benchmark.

limits: No live provider or image-generation provider completion was tested. A client image-generation skill may supply an actual PNG/JPEG artifact; import does not imply generation.

Stamps are raster appearance, not engraving or STEP texture export; general curved UV unwrapping and independent face transparency sorting are outside scope. Path tracing explicitly falls back to raster.
Exact split accepts the documented single-wire, planar/cylindrical single-face domain and fixed source digest. Unsupported or ambiguous cases reject.
Persistent section contours currently require one connected wire with at most 128 edges; a sketch line defines an infinite plane.

Shell offset validity, degenerate collision meshes and exact compound collision remain open from the reviewed activity. Minimized-size protection is synthetic evidence, not reproduction of the historical snapshot failure.
Kernel operations already executing finish atomically before steering affects subsequent work. Drawings still require an explicit user request.
Hosted CI and manual user acceptance are separate gates. No manufacturing qualification or general speedup is claimed.
